resources.string: Decodes “%1$s” the way the sync will: 16 kHz mono, in 30 s windows. Measures time and memory.
Play a song stored on the phone first.

%1$s

Time: %8$s s (%9$s× real time)
Memory: %10$s at start, peak %11$s %12$s
Level: RMS %13$s · peak %14$s
